description: This source file contains unit tests for the DittoPublicKeyProvider class. It tests the behavior of fetching, caching, and error handling for public keys used in JWT authentication within the security module of the Ditto gateway service.

classes.name: DittoPublicKeyProviderTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the behavior of DittoPublicKeyProvider, focusing on key retrieval, caching, and error handling.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem and configures mocks before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Terminates the ActorSystem after each test.

methods.name: verifyThatKeyIsCached
methods.description: Tests that a retrieved public key is cached and subsequent requests use the cache.

methods.name: verifyThatKeyIsNotCachedOnErrorResponseFromDiscoveryEndpoint
methods.description: Ensures that no key is cached if the discovery endpoint returns an error.

methods.name: verifyThatKeyIsNotCachedIfResponseDoesNotContainKeyId
methods.description: Checks that no key is cached when the public keys response does not contain a matching key ID.

methods.name: mockSuccessfulDiscoveryEndpointRequest
methods.description: Sets up a mock successful response for the discovery endpoint request.

methods.name: mockErrorDiscoveryEndpointRequest
methods.description: Sets up a mock error response for the discovery endpoint request.

methods.name: mockSuccessfulPublicKeysRequest
methods.description: Mocks a successful response returning a valid set of public keys including the expected key ID.

methods.name: mockSuccessfulPublicKeysRequestWithoutMatchingKeyId
methods.description: Mocks a successful public keys response that does not contain the expected key ID.
